title: FibonacciVortex: Novel Vortex Core with φ-Modulated Circulation
description: Vortex core model where circulation depends on distance via Fibonacci-weighted φ-exponential: Γ(r) = Γ₀·Σ F_k·φ^(−k·r/r_c). Gives hierarchy of scales with self-similarity Γ(φr)/Γ(r) → 1/φ. No analogous model found in literature.
